_comment: Business pricing knobs. Edit these; never the data/ files. TODO markers must be filled in before quoting real customers.
_discount: Dealer cost = book list x this. 0.77 = 23% off list — confirmed to the cent against Cantor test order 125401135 (21 windows, 2026-08-04).
_price_multiplier: Book-year drift knob. Confirmed 1.0 on 2026-08-04: the 2023 v18 book prices still match Cantor exactly.
_item_discounts: Per-item multipliers on top of 'discount'. Calibrated from Cantor order 125401159 (triple test, 2026-08-04): the full triple package (both LoE panes billed + triple upcharge x 0.6162 + free 90/5 gas) nets to exactly $7.35/sqft-tier. 0.6162 = ~38.4% off the triple upcharge column. argon_krypton_5050 = 0.0: 90/5 mix free (confirmed).
_install: User rule 2026-08-04: installation = $23 x window sqft (W x H in inches / 144), minimum 10 sqft per window. Applied per lite on combinations/bay-bow; patio doors use their frame area. Install is not discounted (own labour) and is marked up with the windows at 'markup'.
_engine: Rules the book leaves ambiguous, calibrated to the cent against Cantor orders 125401135 + 125401159 (2026-08-04). Without brickmould: accessory footage = exact perimeter. With brickmould: billed window size = BM outer dims (W+2x width) and footage = 2(W+H)+8x width — handled automatically. colour: capstock % billed on the base column only at 3/4 of the book pct (Jet Black 20% -> 15%; only black verified). brickmould_override: Cantor's installed 1-inch Classic BM is EP326 at 5.00/5.60 per lf, not the book's EP-226 4.00 row. oversize_glass: 6mm at $8.00/sqft list past 35 sqft (double). mullion: order 125401186 (AW5 72x72) billed the horizontal steel mullion as 1" EP-155 at the 22.00/lf vertical rate, not the book's 2" EP-156 at 30.00; mulled lites are billed at division + 2x assembly brickmould. nailing_flange_override: Window City order 125401151 (Ranj triplex, 2026-07-17, all Jet Black with 5 1/2-inch wood jamb) billed jamb + flange at $8.00/lf list vs the book's 5.00 + 2.00; the extra $1/lf goes on the flange for white and colour alike (white unverified; erring high because under-quoting costs margin). Argon on triple was not billed on that order but is still charged here (over-quoting accepted).
_engine_patio: WC-500 sliding doors, calibrated to the cent on orders 125401186 (Common Configs V2/V3, 24 standard doors, white and Jet Black/White) and 125401100/125401102 (April 2026). Door, glass, assembly, kick lock and colour are billed at 0.81 of list (not 0.77); brickmould and wood jamb at the normal discount. Brickmould EP326 is 5.00/lf white and 5.80/lf coloured on doors (5.60 on windows). A 4 1/2in patio jamb is 4.00/lf; deeper jambs use the window wood-jamb rows. Triple pane bills the LoE 180 add plus the triple package. Footage = W + 2H + 6in (2 panel) or + 8in (4 panel), rounded up to an even inch. Kick lock 40.00 per operating panel pair. Black in/out (order 125401100, one 6ft OX triple) carried 158.39 list on top of the book's black in/out add - black/black hardware and kick lock; confirm on a second black/black door, especially a 4-panel.
_defaults: New window lines start with a 5 1/2in primed wood jamb and new patio doors with a 4 1/2in primed wood jamb (user rules 2026-09-28). Reps can pick another depth or a custom depth and can leave a jamb unfinished. Primed white is only offered up to 6 1/4in on windows and 4 1/2in on patio doors; a deeper jamb is always unfinished.
